ui.browser.media_permission.label.role: accessible region name — browser camera/microphone permission band
ui.browser.media_permission.label.note: Names the band above the page asking for camera/microphone access.

ui.browser.media_permission.message.role: prompt text — browser permission band, like Chrome's site permission prompt
ui.browser.media_permission.message.note: site = the requesting website's host (e.g. meet.google.com), never translated. devices select: audio = microphone only, video = camera only, other = both. Keep every select arm.

ui.browser.media_permission.agent_tab_hi.note: Shown only on agent-driven tabs: the Allow answer is not remembered there. 'Allow' refers to the adjacent button; use the same word as the allow key.

ui.browser.media_permission.allow.note: Grants camera/microphone to the site. Keep as short as English.

ui.browser.media_permission.block.note: Denies and remembers the denial for the site. Keep as short as English.

ui.browser.media_permission.dismiss.role: accessible label for an icon-only close button
ui.browser.media_permission.dismiss.note: Closes the band, denying this one request without remembering.

ui.browser.media_permission.system_block.note: macOS privacy settings (TCC) refuse this app's device access. 'Local Operator' is the product name: do not translate. devices select as in message.
Points to macOS System Settings › Privacy & Security; use the locale's official macOS names where Apple localizes them.
